name: Eschatology
overview: Eschatology, as revealed in Scripture, centers on the future return of Jesus Christ and the final consummation of God's kingdom. Jesus foretells the preaching of the gospel to all nations as a precursor to the end (Matthew 24:14), and promises to come again to receive believers to Himself (John 14:3). The hope of Christ’s glorious appearing is a blessed expectation for the church, with His second coming bringing salvation to those who eagerly await Him (Titus 2:13; Hebrews 9:28). Ultimately, this future includes eternal destinies where the righteous enter everlasting life, and the unrighteous face everlasting punishment (Matthew 25:46).
